title: Dukkham
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca || || Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || pe || pahitatto vihareyyan ti || || 4 Yaṃ kho bhikkhu dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabboti || || Aññātam Bhagavā aññātaṃ Sugatāti || || 5 Yathā katham pana tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsīti || || 6 Rūpaṃ kho bhante dukkhaṃ || tatra me chando pahātabbo || || Vedanā || || Saññā || || Saṅkhārā || || Viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ || tatra me chando pahātabbo || || Imassa khvāham bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attham ājānāmīti || 7 Sādhu sādhu bhikkhu || sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsi || || Rupaṃ kho bhikkhu dukkhaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo || Vedanā || || Saññā || || Saṅkhārā || || Viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo || || Imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti || || 8-9 ||Pa || || Aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosi || ||
